args.script:
import csv, tempfile, os

src = "orders.csv"
out_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="orders_print_")
out_path = os.path.join(out_dir, "printed_rows.txt")

with open(src, newline="") as f, open(out_path, "w") as out:
    r = csv.reader(f)
    header = next(r)
    out.write(",".join(header) + "\n")
    n = 0
    for line in r:
        print(",".join(line))            # print every row, one per line
        out.write(",".join(line) + "\n") # capture the same printed output
        n += 1

print("\n--- printed lines (incl. header):", n + 1, "to", out_path, file=__import__("sys").stderr)
print(out_path)
